faqItems.a1: WatchSphere is a professional B2B marketplace for luxury watch dealers. It provides real-time market data, order book functionality, and a secure trading environment.
faqItems.q2: How do I list a watch for sale?
faqItems.a2: Go to your Inventory, click 'Create new listing', fill in the watch details including photos, condition, and price, then publish your listing.
faqItems.q3: How does the order book work?
faqItems.a3: The order book shows all active buy and sell orders for a specific watch reference. You can place buy orders (bids) or sell orders (asks) at your desired price.
faqItems.a4: WatchSphere offers a free tier with basic features. Premium subscriptions unlock advanced analytics, unlimited listings, and priority support.
faqItems.a5: Prices are determined by supply and demand through our order book system. Market prices reflect the latest traded prices and current bid/ask spreads.
faqItems.a6: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. All communications are encrypted end-to-end.
faqItems.q7: How do I contact a seller?
faqItems.a7: You can message any seller directly through our built-in chat system. Simply click 'Contact' on their listing or visit their profile.
faqItems.q8: What is the Social Search feature?
faqItems.a8: Social Search allows you to browse and search through imported WhatsApp messages from watch trading groups, helping you find deals and connect with traders.
faqItems.q9: How do I report a problem?
faqItems.a9: Go to Settings > Support > Report an Issue. Fill in the details and our support team will investigate promptly.
faqItems.q10: Can I use WatchSphere on mobile?
faqItems.a10: Yes! WatchSphere is available as a mobile app for iOS and Android, with the same features as the web platform.

howItWorks.title: How WatchSphere Works
howItWorks.description: From browsing to buying, here's your journey with WatchSphere.

step1.label: Step 1
step1.title: Create Your Account
step1.description: Sign up in seconds with your email. Verify your identity to unlock full trading features and connect with verified dealers worldwide.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.title: Browse the Market
step2.description: Explore thousands of luxury watches from brands like Rolex, Patek Philippe, and Audemars Piguet. Filter by brand, condition, year, and location.

step3.label: Step 3
step3.title: Place Your Order
step3.description: Found the perfect watch? Place a buy order at your price or accept an existing ask. Our order book ensures transparent, fair pricing.

step4.label: Step 4
step4.title: Secure Transaction
step4.description: Complete your purchase through our secure escrow system. We handle authentication, payment, and delivery so you can buy with confidence.
